decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt on fruit puree sits close to the core dairy range and costs little to keep, but its absence from the website in 2020 to 2021 means its value has not been confirmed since the award, so the option is kept open at moderate risk.

The firm has already dropped four of its five 2018 cheese launches, and this line has shown no visible results since 2018, which raises the risk of withdrawal; its several variants still allow weaker ones to be pruned without abandoning the whole line, so it is kept for now.
